author: Thomas à Kempis
title: Of pure and entire resignation of self, for the obtaining liberty of heart

verses.text: “My Son, lose thyself and thou shalt find Me.
verses.modernizedText: “My Son, lose yourself and you will find Me.

verses.text: Stand still without all choosing and all thought of self, and thou shalt ever be a gainer.
verses.modernizedText: Stand still without all choosing and all thought of self, and you will ever be a gainer.

verses.text: For more grace shall be added to thee, as soon as thou resignest thyself, and so long as thou dost not turn back to take thyself again.”
verses.modernizedText: For more grace will be added to you as soon as you resign yourself, and so long as you do not turn back to take yourself again.”

verses.text: O Lord, how often shall I resign myself, and in what things shall I lose myself?
verses.modernizedText: O Lord, how often shall I resign myself, and in what things shall I lose myself?

verses.text: “Always; every hour: in that which is little, and in that which is great.
verses.modernizedText: “Always; every hour: in that which is little, and in that which is great.

verses.text: I make no exception, but will that thou be found naked in all things.
verses.modernizedText: I make no exception, but will that you be found naked in all things.

verses.text: Otherwise how canst thou be Mine and I thine, unless thou be inwardly and outwardly free from every will of thine own?
verses.modernizedText: Otherwise how can you be Mine and I yours, unless you are inwardly and outwardly free from every will of your own?

verses.text: The sooner thou dost this, the better shall it be with thee; and the more fully and sincerely, the more thou shalt please Me, and the more abundantly shalt thou be rewarded.
verses.modernizedText: The sooner you do this, the better it will be with you; and the more fully and sincerely, the more you will please Me, and the more abundantly you will be rewarded.

verses.text: “Some resign themselves, but with certain reservations, for they do not fully trust in God, therefore they think that they have some provision to make for themselves.
verses.modernizedText: “Some resign themselves, but with certain reservations, for they do not fully trust in God; therefore they think that they have some provision to make for themselves.

verses.text: Some again at first offer everything; but afterwards being pressed by temptation they return to their own devices, and thus make no progress in virtue.
verses.modernizedText: Some again at first offer everything; but afterwards, being pressed by temptation, they return to their own devices, and thus make no progress in virtue.

verses.text: They will not attain to the true liberty of a pure heart, nor to the grace of My sweet companionship, unless they first entirely resign themselves and daily offer themselves up as a sacrifice; without this the union which bringeth forth fruit standeth not nor will stand.
verses.modernizedText: They will not attain the true liberty of a pure heart, or the grace of My sweet companionship, unless they first entirely resign themselves and daily offer themselves up as a sacrifice; without this the union which brings forth fruit does not stand and will not stand.

verses.text: “Many a time I have said unto thee, and now say again, Give thyself up, resign thyself, and thou shalt have great inward peace.
verses.modernizedText: “Many a time I have said to you, and now say again, Give yourself up, resign yourself, and you will have great inward peace.

verses.text: Give all for all; demand nothing, ask nothing in return; stand simply and with no hesitation in Me, and thou shalt possess Me.
verses.modernizedText: Give all for all; demand nothing, ask nothing in return; stand simply and with no hesitation in Me, and you will possess Me.

verses.text: Thou shalt have liberty of heart, and the darkness shall not overwhelm thee.
verses.modernizedText: You will have liberty of heart, and the darkness will not overwhelm you.

verses.text: For this strive thou, pray for it, long after it, that thou mayest be delivered from all possession of thyself, and nakedly follow Jesus who was made naked for thee; mayest die unto thyself and live eternally to Me.
verses.modernizedText: For this strive, pray for it, long after it, that you may be delivered from all possession of yourself, and nakedly follow Jesus who was made naked for you; may die to yourself and live eternally to Me.

verses.text: Then shall all vain fancies disappear, all evil disturbings, and superfluous cares.
verses.modernizedText: Then all vain fancies will disappear, all evil disturbances, and unnecessary cares.

verses.text: Then also shall immoderate fear depart from thee, and inordinate love shall die.”
verses.modernizedText: Then also immoderate fear will depart from you, and inordinate love will die.”
